_comment: Documented vulnerabilities of the vulnerable-by-design apps, verified line by line at the pinned commit; `tool` is the aix code tool whose report on that file must name file:line.

NodeGoat.what: A1 injection: eval of request input, static rule

pygoat.what: A1 SQL injection: login.objects.raw(sql_query) built from the request
A1 command injection: subprocess.Popen with request input, shell=True
A1 code injection: eval(val) of request input
A8 insecure deserialisation: yaml.load(file, yaml.Loader) of an upload
path traversal: open(filename) from the request
A10 SSRF: requests.get(url) from the request
CWE-78: subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True) from the request
A8 insecure deserialisation: pickle.loads of a cookie

WebGoat.what: SQL injection lesson 5a: query built by concatenation on lines 62-63, executed on 67
cryptography lesson: MD5 used for a hash

juice-shop.what: SQL injection (search): sequelize.query with a template literal of req.query.q
SQL injection (login): sequelize.query with req.body.email in the template literal
SQL built from strings, static rule
server-side template injection: eval(code) of the username expression
